For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Pranav Kumar
 Mr. Binod Kr. Singh

==
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARVIND SRIVASTAVA  ORAL ORDER 4 20-04-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

Petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Chandauti P.S. Case No. 101 of 2021 registered for the offence under sections 341, 323, 504, 506, 498A/34 of the Indian Penal code and section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has not committed any offence as alleged in the first information report.
Petitioner never demand any dowry nor tortured the informant ever.
Petitioner undertakes to give Rs. 2000/- per month to the informant for her maintenance, as stated in paragraph 3 of the supplementary affidavit.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.56805 of 2022(4) dt.20-04-2023

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties, the petitioner,
above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing personal bond to the satisfaction of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gaya in connection with Chandauti P.S. Case No. 101 of 2021 subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Arvind Srivastava, J) mcv/-
